messages:
Marco (Customer): Hey all — Sunridge Retail here. We'd like to onboard a multilingual (EN/ES) relevance reranker to replace rule-based boosts. Target: precision@10 >= 0.82, p95 latency < 110ms, throughput ~150 qps. Pilot needed in 5 weeks. Any compliance or perf blockers?
Nora (CSM): thanks Marco — capturing. Quick Q: does data include any PHI/SSNs? Hosted ok or need Dedicated/Private?
Marco (Customer): No PHI, but notes contain customer names and order ids. Hosted preferred for speed, but open to Dedicated for SLA. This pilot is important for our renewal.
Ben (Solutions): plan: 1) neutralized sample (<=8k) + labels 2) quality eval (precision@10, MRR) 3) perf sweep on small 7B and trimmed 13B 4) canary routing + rollback triggers.
Hana (Safety): flag: records contain partial payment references. Require PII redaction step, NER recall > 0.95, and a numeric hallucination test for amounts. Logs should be masked for 30d retention. If Dedicated, require KMS keys.
Pri (AE): FYI renewal team flagged this as a key milestone; delays >4 weeks escalate. Please provide a one-pager risk mitigation after perf runs.
Nora (CSM): Marco can you upload a neutralized csv and a short label guide? Also confirm acceptance thresholds — Marco you set precision@10 >= 0.82, we should confirm.
Marco (Customer): uploading now: "sunridge_rerank_samples.csv" and "label_guide.md". Confirmed: precision@10 >= 0.82.
infra-bot: ticket CS-11999 created and assigned to ben.solutions. Perf slot requested next Thu.
Ben (Solutions): I'll run perf like:
```bash
redwood test perf --model redwood-7b-q4f16 --dataset sunridge_rerank_samples.csv --concurrency 6 --metrics latency,p95,throughput
```
Ben (Solutions): If p95 >110ms on hosted, recommend Dedicated gpu family + micro-batching; will include cost delta.
Hana (Safety): I'll post a short safety rubric (PII redaction, hallucination probes). Also propose a 20-item adversarial set.
Nora (CSM): scheduling 30-min kickoff Mon 11am PT. Action items: Marco upload (M), Hana safety rubric (H), Ben perf + cost delta (B), Nora kickoff + renewal one-pager (N). Follow-up thread after perf results. :white_check_mark:
